title: cistus × stenophyllus var. sennenii
intro: Cistus × stenophyllus var. sennenii, commonly known as Sennen's rockrose, is a hybrid plant species within the Cistus genus, known for its fragrant white flowers and evergreen foliage. This plant is rich in flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Cistus × stenophyllus var. sennenii include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve wound healing, as well as its antioxidant and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial therapeutic actions.
